# rnw-community

> TypeScript monorepo of `@rnw-community/*` npm packages for NestJS, React, React Native, and React Native Web: shared
> utilities, framework-agnostic method decorators, NestJS RxJS modules, and React Native UI and payments libraries.

pnpm 11 workspace orchestrated by Turbo and released by Lerna in fixed-version mode. Every public package ships dual
ESM + CJS with type declarations and requires Node 22+. Each package root has a `readme.md` (public API with one
example per export), an `AGENTS.md` (layout, patterns, commands, coverage), and an `llms.txt` (agent entry point).

## Repository

- [README.md](README.md): Package catalog and badges.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Repository conventions for contributors and agents: commands, file organization, comments
  policy, `@rnw-community/shared` primitives, ESM build invariants, PR review and merge policy.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, commands, and pull request requirements.
- [RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md): Versioning model and the automated npm release workflow.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Supported versions and private vulnerability reporting.

## Core utilities

- [@rnw-community/shared](packages/shared/llms.txt): Type guards, utility types, and helpers (`isDefined`, `emptyFn`,
  `wait`, `Maybe`, ...) used by every other package. Docs: [readme](packages/shared/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/shared/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/object-field-tree](packages/object-field-tree/llms.txt): Typed nested field-combination trees built
  from a data-generator callback. Docs: [readme](packages/object-field-tree/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/object-field-tree/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/rxjs-errors](packages/rxjs-errors/llms.txt): RxJS operators and error classes for filtering and
  rethrowing errors in observables. Docs: [readme](packages/rxjs-errors/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/rxjs-errors/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/redux-loadable](packages/redux-loadable/llms.txt): Redux loading/error state slice, selectors, and
  helpers for request lifecycles. Docs: [readme](packages/redux-loadable/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/redux-loadable/AGENTS.md).

## Method decorators

- [@rnw-community/decorators-core](packages/decorators-core/llms.txt): Framework-agnostic interceptor primitive the log,
  histogram, and lock decorators are built on. Docs: [readme](packages/decorators-core/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/decorators-core/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/log-decorator](packages/log-decorator/llms.txt): Method decorator with pre/post/error logging hooks and
  a pluggable transport. Docs: [readme](packages/log-decorator/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/log-decorator/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/histogram-metric-decorator](packages/histogram-metric-decorator/llms.txt): Method decorator that
  records call duration into any histogram transport. Docs: [readme](packages/histogram-metric-decorator/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/histogram-metric-decorator/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/lock-decorator](packages/lock-decorator/llms.txt): Sequential and exclusive method lock decorators for
  Promise and Observable methods. Docs: [readme](packages/lock-decorator/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/lock-decorator/AGENTS.md).

## NestJS

- [@rnw-community/nestjs-enterprise](packages/nestjs-enterprise/llms.txt): Enterprise-grade NestJS decorators and
  modules built on the decorator packages. Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-enterprise/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-enterprise/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-logger](packages/nestjs-rxjs-logger/llms.txt): NestJS logger wrapper exposing pipeable
  RxJS logging operators. Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-rxjs-logger/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-rxjs-logger/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-metrics](packages/nestjs-rxjs-metrics/llms.txt): NestJS Prometheus metrics wrapper for
  RxJS streams. Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-rxjs-metrics/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-rxjs-metrics/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-redis](packages/nestjs-rxjs-redis/llms.txt): NestJS Redis wrapper for RxJS streams. Docs:
  [readme](packages/nestjs-rxjs-redis/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-rxjs-redis/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-lock](packages/nestjs-rxjs-lock/llms.txt): Redis-backed distributed lock for NestJS with
  RxJS. Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-rxjs-lock/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-rxjs-lock/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-typed-config](packages/nestjs-typed-config/llms.txt): Strongly typed NestJS configuration.
  Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-typed-config/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-typed-config/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc](packages/nestjs-webpack-swc/llms.txt): Webpack and SWC configuration helpers for
  fast NestJS builds. Docs: [readme](packages/nestjs-webpack-swc/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/nestjs-webpack-swc/AGENTS.md).

## React Native and React Native Web

- [@rnw-community/react-native-payments](packages/react-native-payments/llms.txt): W3C Payment Request API for React
  Native (Apple Pay on iOS, Google Pay on Android) with an Expo config plugin. Docs:
  [readme](packages/react-native-payments/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/react-native-payments/AGENTS.md),
  [full docs](packages/react-native-payments/llms-full.txt).
- [@rnw-community/react-native-collapsible-header](packages/react-native-collapsible-header/llms.txt): Slot-based
  Reanimated collapsible header with provider-based scroll wiring, snap, and overlay mode. Docs:
  [readme](packages/react-native-collapsible-header/readme.md),
  [AGENTS](packages/react-native-collapsible-header/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/react-native-screen-chrome](packages/react-native-screen-chrome/llms.txt): Safe-area screen structure,
  progressive edge fades, and compound collapsible chrome around one scrollable. Docs:
  [readme](packages/react-native-screen-chrome/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/react-native-screen-chrome/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/platform](packages/platform/llms.txt): Platform detection constants and helpers for React Native Web.
  Docs: [readme](packages/platform/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/platform/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/fast-style](packages/fast-style/llms.txt): Rapid React Native flex and font styling utilities. Docs:
  [readme](packages/fast-style/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/fast-style/AGENTS.md).

## Tooling

- [@rnw-community/wdio](packages/wdio/llms.txt): WebdriverIO commands, page objects, and helpers for end-to-end tests.
  Docs: [readme](packages/wdio/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/wdio/AGENTS.md).
- [@rnw-community/eslint-plugin](packages/eslint-plugin/llms.txt): ESLint plugin with React and React Native rules such
  as `no-complex-jsx-logic`. Docs: [readme](packages/eslint-plugin/readme.md), [AGENTS](packages/eslint-plugin/AGENTS.md).

## Optional

- [react-native-payments-example](packages/react-native-payments-example/readme.md): Private, unpublished. Bare and Expo
  example apps for `react-native-payments`.
- [react-native-collapsible-header-example](packages/react-native-collapsible-header-example/readme.md): Private,
  unpublished. Bare and Expo example apps, Maestro e2e suite, and demo recordings for `react-native-collapsible-header`.
- [react-native-screen-chrome-example](packages/react-native-screen-chrome-example/readme.md): Private, unpublished. Bare
  and Expo example apps for `react-native-screen-chrome`.
